issues.en: No priest is named. The mother's first name is mostly lost and her maiden name is garbled. The text has 'Сапреговъ' (supruga) in place of a surname, so the family surname is taken from the margin, Сам[?]. The parish reads 'Куневскаго', taken as Kulių [?]. The godparents' line is garbled.

issues.en: Twins. The township (Жороннской) and the father's name are garbled; 'Воспрамъ' in the parents' line is ignored. Only one surname (Кучинскихъ) follows the mother's name, so it is taken as the family surname (it may be her maiden name). The godparents' line is garbled and the start is lost. The sex of the second twin is taken from the name Mieczysław.
issues.lt: Dvyniai. Valsčius (Жороннской) ir tėvo vardas iškraipyti; 'Воспрамъ' tėvų eilutėje praleista. Po motinos vardo yra tik viena pavardė (Кучинскихъ), todėl laikoma šeimos pavarde (galbūt tai jos mergautinė). Krikštatėvių eilutė iškraipyta, pradžia dingusi. Antrojo dvynio lytis spėjama pagal vardą Mečislovas.
